text:
ayan: Late-night LAN idea: horror co-op marathon + a tiny speedrun relay on the side. Projector for the spooky bits, low lights, headphone splitters for VR-ish audio? :ghost:
brett: Love this. I can bring Dead by Daylight + Left 4 Dead 2 copies. Also a tiny fog machine? kidding... maybe. :sweat_smile:
mira: I'll bring my headset splitter and a headphone amp. Also volunteer to time the speedrun relay (20m slots).
oshin: I'm in. Can someone bring a capture dongle? want to clip the best jump scares.
cat: I can bring one. Also volunteering to moderate the chill rules: no spoilers, keep chat text-only for story games.
ayan: poll-time poll: 1) Marathon horror 2) Speedrun relay 3) Indie horror demos. React with :one:/:two:/:three:.
sync-bot: Poll created: 1) Marathon horror 2) Speedrun relay 3) Indie horror demos.
brett: :one: and :two: (can't decide)
mira: :three: — I have some short indie demos that fit 15-20min each.
oshin: For speedruns, propose categories: Any% (shortest completion) or Scavenger (collect items). Thoughts?
cat: Scavenger sounds more spectator-friendly. :eyes:
brett: Scavenger then. I'll write a tiny bracket spreadsheet.
ayan: logistics: setup 7pm, start 7:30. Projector & dimmers confirmed. Bring cushions, extra chairs. Food: who wants pizza?
mira: yes pizza. vegan + one with mushrooms.
oshin: I'll grab a capture dongle + HDMI splitter. Also a mini-UPS for the router so Parsec/streaming doesn't hiccup.
cat: I'll bring a labelmaker to tag controllers, and a little sign for the "quiet corner".
sync-bot: Calendar event created: "Late-night LAN: Spooky + Speedrun Relay" (root_ts: 1998765432).
ayan: Awesome. RSVP so I can order food. Also please mark if you need a guaranteed controller or charger slot.
brett: RSVP here — need a controller and charger.
mira: RSVP — charger slot.
oshin: RSVP — capture & cable.
cat: RSVP — snack steward and quiet corner duty.
ayan: Perfect. See you Saturday night! :jack_o_lantern:
